scope.rule: ENTSOG interconnection, storage, LNG, production and trading points with an operator in a scope country, plus the balance's landing points; distribution and final-consumer points are left out.

source.name: ENTSOG Transparency Platform
source.terms: ENTSOG TP Privacy & T&C of Use, LAG0689-26 Rev. 3 (10 November 2026), Article 5; see docs/legal/DATA_SOURCE_TERMS.md

coordinate_rule: Positions are ENTSOG's map coordinates (tpMapX/tpMapY) transformed to an approximate lon/lat for display, as the live ingestion does; never surveyed. A point ENTSOG publishes without a map position has no coordinate and is counted as not located.
edge_rule: Zone membership (type virtual): each located point to the virtual trading point of each entry-exit zone its operators belong to; membership of a market area, never a line. Adjacency (types market_area_link, interconnector): which market areas each interconnection point joins, from ENTSOG interconnections (see the adjacency block); route pricing walks these and the map draws them. All edges are schematic.
access_flags: annual, monthly, daily, day-ahead products offered; CAM; CMP relevant

adjacency.rule: ENTSOG interconnections and connection points: aliases of one physical point and physical points of a virtual interconnection point are folded; each side of a valid row resolves to a pipeline (a TSO system ENTSOG lists at exactly two points) or to its balancing zone's trading point; a located point joining two in-network market areas or pipelines gets a market_area_link to each market area; a pipeline whose two located ends each join a market area gets an interconnector edge; one representative point per pair of market areas.
